name: Amayakashitari Shinai zo! ~Chiisaku Natte Junjou Kachiki na Aoba Onee-chan ni Shikari Kawaigarareru Tsundere Kozukuri~
original_name: 甘やかしたりしないぞ！ ～小さくなって純情勝気な青葉お姉ちゃんに叱り可愛がられるツンデレ子作り～
source:
His three lovely neighbors were like big sisters.
He longed to embrace them but couldn't say it, so the eldest slipped him a drug to relax.
The drug unexpectedly shrunk him from man to boy-size. Now he's cuter than ever!
Which of the sister should look after the reduced protagonist? He chooses the one
who runs hot and cold with kindness and fury, and his sweet babymaking life begins!

Severity can be love too!? This rather naive tsundere blonde with enormous breasts
can sting like a whip, but then she's dewey sweet and she lavishes love his throbbing member!
And her sharp attitude changes after the pregnancy.
Don't miss out on the hot, hot passion of such romantic mood swings!

Enjoy more sweeeet stories with these generous onesans! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109462.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
他可爱的三个邻居就像大姐姐一样。
他渴望拥抱她们却说不出口，于是大姐偷偷给他下了放松的药。
药意外地把他从大人缩小到了小孩的大小。现在他比以前更可爱了！
应该由哪个姐姐来照顾缩小的主人公？他选择了那个时而温柔时而暴躁的姐姐，甜蜜的造人生活就此开始！

严厉也可以是爱！？这个相当天真的傲娇金发巨乳美女，
可以像鞭子一样抽打你，但随后又甜蜜如露，用爱抚慰你悸动的肉棒！
怀孕后她的尖锐态度也会改变。
不要错过这种浪漫情绪波动中火热、火热的激情！

和这些慷慨的大姐姐们一起享受更多甜蜜的故事吧！
